title.zh: 将曼达卢永市 Mauway 附属校改设为名为 Mandaluyong East 中学的独立中学并为其提供经费
title.en: An Act Converting the Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex in Mandaluyong City into a Separate High School to be known as the Mandaluyong East High School and providing funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex in Mandaluyong City into a Separate High School to be known as the Mandaluyong East High School and providing funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex thành Mandaluyong East High School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะ Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex เป็น Mandaluyong East High School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex menjadi Mandaluyong East High School
title.ms: Akta menukar Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex kepada Mandaluyong East High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8769_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Mandaluyong High School — Mauway Annex in Barangay Mauway, City of Mandaluyong is hereby separated from the Mandaluyong High School in the City of Mandaluyong and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Mandaluyong East High School.

The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall prescribe the rules and regulations necessary for the conversion of the Mandaluyong High School - Mauway Annex into an independent national public high school.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Mandaluyong High School - Mauway Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Mandaluyong East High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mandaluyong High School - Mauway Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Mandaluyong East High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
